newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Crown shares top Tuesday turnover.
newsitem.headline: Crown shares top Tuesday turnover.

text.p: Shares in casino operator Crown Ltd topped turnover on Tuesday with 20.3 million shares traded.
The bulk of the trade was in three lines totalling 20 million, all at A$2.20 per share, specialled through Prudential-Bache Securities (Australia).
Brokers speculated the trades involved double counting with a line of 10 million shares put through followed by two lines of five million each.
Ten million shares equates to about 1.3 percent of Crown's issued ordinary capital.
A Crown spokesman was unavailable for comment.
By 12.05 p.m. (0205 GMT), Crown shares were three cents higher at A$2.16 on turnover of 20.7 million shares.
